---
title: "About the Series"
---

The Statistics Seminar Series provides a forum for researchers, students, and invited guests to share and discuss their work, exchange ideas, and advance research across diverse areas of statistics and its applications.

## Attend

Regular meeting time: Thursdays 12:30 - 1:20 pm, VAB 2012
